president.name: JULIEN VALROS
president.quote: « We are not only judging films, but visions of desirable futures created with tools that still surpass our understanding. This is the beginning of a new era. »
president.description: Award-winning Marseille-based filmmaker, Julien Valros brings his uncompromising eye for storytelling and cinematic emotion.

aiko.name: AIKO SATO
aiko.bio: An expert in diffusion models, she analyzes the technical prowess of prompts.

julie.name: JULIE MASSON
julie.bio: Founder of "Future Pictures", she seeks the new talents of tomorrow's image.

marc.name: MARC AUBIN
marc.bio: A specialist in lighting, he oversees the aesthetic quality of augmented creations.

scoring_chart.intro: The jury commits to evaluating each short film according to four fundamental pillars to guarantee fairness among participants.

originality.title: AI ORIGINALITY
originality.description: The relevance and boldness of the use of generative tools.

aesthetic.title: VISUAL AESTHETICS
aesthetic.description: The coherence and beauty of the overall rendering.

narrative.title: NARRATIVE QUALITY
narrative.description: The strength of the story told in just 60 seconds.

impact.title: EMOTION AND IMPACT
impact.description: The film's ability to move the viewer.
